cohort: The study included 25,631 cesarean section births, consisting of 89% Turkish citizens and 11% refugees/asylum seekers.
finding: Robson groups, fetal presentation, gestational age, Apgar scores, and newborn weight/height were identified as significant risk factors for neonatal/postneonatal mortality, with the highest mortality rates observed in Robson groups R8, R9, R10, R6, and R7.
mod_finding: The study found significant variation in cesarean section mortality rates across different Robson groups and emphasized the Robson Classification's utility in assessing cesarean section outcomes.
followup_time: Up to postneonatal period (typically 1 year after birth)
